name: marketing-studio
description: Lets Claude capture your app and website screens (also behind a login) and turn its own designs into posts, carousels and videos.
long_description: Claude does the creative work: the idea, the copy, the design, the motion and any music. Marketing Studio is its camera, checker and export button. It takes screenshots and screen recordings of your app and website (a quick low-quality look first, then high quality), also on pages behind a login, checks Claude's designs the way a phone will show them, plays the music Claude writes with real instruments or uses the voiceover and music you supply, and exports finished image and video files with the real screens in them, right in the chat. Everything runs and is saved on your own laptop.

output_dir.title: Where to save your work
output_dir.description: A "Marketing Studio" folder is made inside it, with one folder per project and an Inbox for voiceovers and music you supply.

demo_phone.title: Demo account phone number
demo_phone.description: The Anokhi Reet test account used for pages behind the login (a Supabase test number, so no SMS is sent).

demo_code.title: Demo account code
demo_code.description: The test account's fixed code (ask the owner). Kept securely on this laptop.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Is Marketing Studio ready on this laptop: sites and pages, sign-in, brands, recent projects.

tools.name: guide
tools.description: How to make posts, carousels and Reels that work: best practices and how to use these tools for them.

tools.name: brand
tools.description: The brand to design with: colours, fonts, logos, patterns, sizes, rules and claims never to make.

tools.name: find_page
tools.description: Find the page someone means in the site's live list of pages (new pages are found by themselves).

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: What is on a page as text (headings, buttons, fields), to plan shots without screenshots.

tools.name: capture
tools.description: Screenshots of a page or pasted link (phone or desktop, also behind the login), several in one go: preview, then high quality.

tools.name: record
tools.description: A smooth screen recording of a page from steps (scroll, tap, type, move a slider).

tools.name: inbox
tools.description: The folder for voiceovers, music and images people supply; audio length and spoken parts.

tools.name: export
tools.description: Turn Claude's own HTML design into finished PNG slides or an MP4 video with the real screens, shown in the chat, with sound (a supplied voiceover or music, or music Claude writes).

tools.name: check
tools.description: Check a design privately before exporting it: pictures and a layout check (text, sizes, empty space, safe zones).

tools.name: projects
tools.description: Earlier work: what was captured and exported, and the design to revise.

tools.name: show
tools.description: Shows a finished design in the chat again, with Copy and Show-in-folder buttons.

tools.name: sign_in
tools.description: Check or redo the sign-in for pages behind the login.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Get the result of a long job (a recording or a video export).
